chapter: Marriage and the end of the shows
title: Hotel raid in Danville and a forced marriage
summary: Police raid the hotel and require marriage licenses, so the manager's rule about couples leads Price to marry in North Carolina.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: So we went to Danville, Virginia, and in this hotel... if well, usually the shows...there were five chorus girls that were single, and there were five men that were single, before the evening was over you had five marriages, you know. Not shotgun, but... (laughter)...you know, performed by the manager. That was because he would save the cost of five rooms, you know, an economic solution. That's so if you got married, or if you lived in common law, just sleeping with a person in a room, then that was just one room, see, so instead of having to rent ten rooms, you only had to rent five.
So we were in this hotel in Danville, Virginia. The police raided the hotel and said, 'Everybody out in the hallway.' Well, five doors opened and here are ten people. The man said,

"Now, if this is your wife, I want to see the marriage license. And if it's not your wife, you're going to jail." Well, when I got down to the jail (laughter) the man...the manager of the show...put up a bond and we went...we had to leave Virginia because I was not 21...had to leave Virginia and go to North Carolina, get married, and then bring that license back to Virginia and present it to the man, and whatever bond it was... fifty, a hundred, two hundred dollars, you's get your money back.
